verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI generation docs describe a built-in AI that edits workspace items. You can then ask it to review its changes, and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with those items preselected. That is in-product task delegation. AI Agent steps (windmill-docs-20) are a related but separate capability for running agents inside flows. Missing for 10: detail on what range of tasks the assistant can take on beyond editing and reviewing items, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
